studies.preparation: Simultaneous retinal and dLGN A-lamina extracellular recordings; referenced preparation protocol not fully reviewed.
studies.observable: Conditional efficacy of retinal spikes in linked LGN recordings
studies.finding: Closely spaced retinal spikes have different conditional transfer efficacy; the extracellular result does not identify its cellular mechanism.
limitations: No causal edge weight or carrier threshold is calibrated.
No matched transfer through the rest of the atlas is established.
reviewedLocators: Results, pp. 384-385: paired-spike recordings and mechanism limitation
studies.correctionCheck: Primary publication and/or PubMed metadata checked; no exhaustive correction/retraction search.

studies.preparation: Simultaneous LGN and area 17 simple-cell recordings; full methods remain unread.
studies.finding: The reported functional connections favor matching contrast sign and aligned receptive-field subregions.
limitations: Correlation supports a bounded operating relation, not direct anatomical proof.
Development and stable map formation were not tested by this adopted result.
studies.correctionCheck: Primary publication and/or PubMed metadata checked; no exhaustive correction/retraction search.

studies.preparation: Lightly anaesthetized animals; extracellular single-unit recording with visual stimuli, as described in the numbered abstract.
studies.observable: Orientation and ocular-dominance organization in striate cortex
studies.finding: The abstract reports distinct columnar organizations for orientation and ocular dominance.
limitations: The original 1962 citation refers to cats and cannot silently acquire this DOI.
No species-general necessity or unique cortical construction rule follows.
studies.correctionCheck: Primary publication and/or PubMed metadata checked; no exhaustive correction/retraction search.

studies.preparation: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging; full preparation not reviewed.
studies.observable: Orientation selectivity and local spatial arrangement
studies.finding: Rat V1 shows orientation selectivity without discernible local organization at the reported scale; the cat comparison concerns area 18.
limitations: This limits a universal local-map claim, not the existence of every possible organization.
No direct spike measurement or developmental mechanism is inferred.
studies.correctionCheck: Primary publication and/or PubMed metadata checked; no exhaustive correction/retraction search.

studies.preparation: Selective optogenetic manipulation of layer 6 corticogeniculate projections; behavioral/anesthetic state not verified in the read passages.
studies.observable: dLGN visually evoked responses under projection manipulation
studies.finding: Removing cortical input produces increases or decreases depending on cell and contrast; driving input reduces evoked counts.
limitations: No universal positive gain or necessary rhythm mechanism is established.
Feedback is cortex to thalamus; this does not establish the historical reverse dependency.
studies.correctionCheck: Primary publication and/or PubMed metadata checked; no exhaustive correction/retraction search.

studies.organism: Primate (PubMed Haplorhini indexing); exact species not verified
studies.preparation: FEF stimulation below the saccade threshold with V4 recordings; full methods not reviewed.
studies.observable: V4 visual responses during frontal-eye-field microstimulation
studies.finding: Retinotopically corresponding stimulation enhances V4 responses; noncorresponding stimulation can suppress them.
limitations: A feedback intervention does not establish decision-making necessity or predictive coding.
studies.correctionCheck: Primary publication and/or PubMed metadata checked; no exhaustive correction/retraction search.

comparisons.candidate: Orientation selectivity requires a discernible local feature map in every mammal.
comparisons.alternative: Selectivity and its local spatial organization are separate observables.
comparisons.discriminator: Cell-resolved orientation selectivity and spatial arrangement in the same preparation.
comparisons.limit: Limited to the reported rat V1 imaging scale; not a claim of absent organization at every scale.

comparisons.candidate: A feedback response identifies predictive coding as the unique mechanism.
comparisons.alternative: Feedback effects can be observed without identifying a prediction-error computation.
comparisons.discriminator: A frozen competing-model test with separately manipulated expectations and attention and specified neural readouts.
comparisons.limit: No graph-ranking experiment or model discrimination was executed here.

openObligations: Read remaining full methods and verify preparation state and exact species before extending the abstract-scoped findings.
Review corrections and replications systematically before quantitative calibration.
Test development, external-parent necessity and competing computational mechanisms with matched interventions.
Obtain matched preparations before interpreting any optical-retinal-thalamocortical atlas path as one observed cascade.
